title: Change of variables for Hⁿ-integrals over blow-ups η_{y,r}(S)
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, y ∈ ℝ^Q, r > 0, let S ⊆ ℝ^Q be an arbitrary set and g : ℝ^Q → ℝ an arbitrary function, and let η = η_{y,r}, η(x) = r⁻¹(x − y). Then ∫_{η(S)} g dHⁿ = (rⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_S g(η(x)) dHⁿ(x), where Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q and both sides are Bochner set integrals (no integrability or measurability assumption is made; the identity includes the case where both sides are 0 by non-integrability).
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (y : Eucl Q) (r : ℝ) (S : Set (Eucl Q)) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ z in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y r '' S, g z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in S, g (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y r x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
